clips.title: The story
paras: Dun Modr has fallen to Dark Iron dwarves, leaving the Thandol Span's southern approach in hostile hands. The fortress once changed hands in a fierce struggle during the Second War.

At Wetlands' northern edge, Dun Modr commands the main road between Khaz Modan and the northern human kingdoms. That route has drawn armies to the fortress across the decades. During the Second War, the Orcish Horde seized the dwarven stronghold and used it to launch raids and resist Alliance armies. Stromgarde warriors sailed from Tol Barad to reclaim it, and the Orcs struck back in a bloody struggle. Alliance forces under Lord Anduin Lothar eventually drove the invaders south across the Thandol Span, returning the fortress to dwarven hands.

Dun Modr lay exposed while Ironforge's attention was divided and many of its finest mountaineers served the Alliance abroad. Dark Iron invaders took advantage, sabotaged the Thandol Span with explosives, then swarmed the fortress. Led by the warlock Balgaras the Foul, they overcame the defenders and drove out the Bronzebeard garrison. Mountaineers now hold a grim perimeter just down the road, seeking aid to drive out the occupiers.
